title: 第15章 杨康14第16章 杨康15
content_zh:
陈秀才几人看着丘处机心死如灰的样子，只觉得造化弄人。
诚然丘处机确实是真心实意的想帮他们的，但他们的家人也确实是因为他的逞强好胜而失去了生命！这让他们如何能接受啊！
马五看着丘处机道歉，两眼通红，沉默片刻后走上前打了一巴掌，然后忍不住瘫在地上嚎啕大哭，“秀娘，二狗，你们看到了吗？害你们的人终于道歉了，终于道歉了啊！可你们却再也回不来了！”
全真教的人虽然不满自家人被这么对待，但看着马五的样子也不忍说些什么！毕竟人家说的是事实！
丘处机被打了一巴掌，但却很平静，这是他应该承受的。
“你们如果有谁想打，尽管上前，贫道绝不还手！”
陈秀才读过几年私塾，见识也比别人多一些，他明白这是朝廷要整顿江湖人士，但也不会多说什么！再看看丘处机的样子，忍不住长叹一声：“罢了，冤冤相报何时了！邱道长虽是无心之失，但累及无辜之人却是事实，这巴掌老翁我就不打了，只是希望邱道长能答应我一件事！”
“您说！只要我能办到，一定义不容辞！”
“今日过后，希望邱道长不要再进行所谓的行侠仗义了，老翁不希望再有人落得小女一样的下场！若是邱道长有心，多抄写经文给小女，为她祈求一个安稳的来生吧！”
“您......”
陈秀才没有再多说什么，而是直接转身离去。都说人老成精，他其实也看出来丘处机心存死志，对于这样的人来说，活着反而是最痛苦的事情，这也算是让他赎罪了！但想着自己再也回不来的女儿，陈秀才不由泪流满面！
丘处机看着远去的陈秀才步履蹒跚，心里五味杂陈。
陈安看着眼前的事情解决的差不多了，剩下的事情也不是他能管的，于是走到丘处机跟前，直接通知道：“邱道长，既然这些事情说的差不多了，那我就带着军队退下终南山了！”
说完也不看丘处机的反应，直接大声道：“昔日众位行侠仗义之事我们就不多说了，毕竟也没有人管过，但自今日起，大金境内决不允许再出现私下杀人行凶，如果你发现有作奸犯科的事，可以上报官府，决不允许私自处理，更不允许依仗武力当街斗殴，一经发现，全部严惩！希望到时候不会有人说自己是行侠仗义！毕竟行侠仗义的后果是什么你们也看见了！”
“到时候依法杀人偿命，欠债还钱，可不管你们是不是无心的，错就是错！希望各位谨记于心！当然，也别想着自己武功高强，无所畏惧！毕竟每个人在世上都不是孤零零的一个人，到时候牵连自己的亲朋好友就不好了！”
恩威并施的一番话说完，陈安直接命令手下：“收兵回营！”
在场的江湖中人虽然不满这金人将军的态度，但也不敢多做什么，他们被这一天弄得心神不定，只想赶紧坐下来商讨一下！
本以为只是来终南山看一场热闹，没想到反而把自己牵连进去了！
另一边全真教的人见周围的人都散了，连忙将丘处机扶了起来。
“邱师兄，你还好吧？”

丘处机看着关心自己的人，只觉得无言以对，“我还好，只是这些日子连累你们了！”
“那你日后怎么办啊？今天的事情过不了多久就会传遍大江南北，你......”
看着众人的样子，丘处机安慰道：“我连累那么多无辜之人失去生命，如今我还活着，就已经很好了，日后我会按照与陈秀才的约定，在道馆中抄写经文，你们别为我担心了！我们先回去吧！”
看着丘处机的样子，众人只觉得心痛，平日里自家师兄总是一副性如烈火的样子，突然变成这样，也让人挺难受的！
终南山下的事情很快就随着南来北往的人传遍了大江南北，这也让丘处机和全真教的名声一落千丈！
诚然是无心之失，但被牵连的人又做错了什么呢！
就连自认从未杀过无辜之人的洪七公都沉默良久，更何况其他人呢！
当然，随之传扬开来的还有大金皇帝的旨意，为此，不少摊贩都十分高兴!
他们是真的十分厌恶那些在大街上打架斗殴的人，这要是只损失一点货物还是好的，就怕遇到杀红眼的人，他们也怕被连累丢命啊！
现在这个命令一出，众人只觉得自己摆摊有了保障，再也不怕遇到这些侠士了！
但也有发愁的人，江湖中人自由洒脱惯了，突然给他们加上了一堆限制，这让他们怎么都不习惯，但没办法，形式比人强，他们即使再怎么厉害，也抗不过一个国家，更何况他们的亲朋好友也不是人人武力高强啊！
杨康见这件事情告一段落，也就回到了皇城，不过担心有些人阳奉阴违或者是以身试法，特意交代自己手下的官员严查此类案件，一经发现，绝不姑息！甚至还派人专门到各地巡视，防止底下官员的不重视！
官员们倒是重视，但他们觉得不会有人顶风作案，但偏偏有几个人觉得大金皇帝的这个命令只是说说而已，结果直接撞到了枪口上，杨康直接下令从严处置，其他江湖人士看着这几个人的下场，瞬间老实了很多。
令杨康没想到的是，这命令不单单限制了江湖人，就连街坊邻里的矛盾都少了，大家相处间都和谐了很多，基本不会再出现一言不合就动手的情况！
不过这些江湖人士在大金是老实了，但在大宋西夏还是原来的德行，甚至将在大金所受的委屈一并发泄了出去，这就让人很无奈了，但他暂时也没有理去管，毕竟那不是他的地盘啊！
不过杨康相信，早晚有一日，他一定能彻底改变这些江湖人士的习惯！
杨康看着书房里面悬挂着的版图，想着江湖如今算是平静了下来，日后他也可以全神贯注的发展朝堂了，他一定要尽快结束这种局面，完成一统！
当年始皇帝一句‘受命于天，既寿永昌’是激起了多少华夏男儿心中的热血！
与其让蒙古人南下中原，还不如自己来呢！
想一想多少古迹泯灭在战火中，又有多少人被战争裹挟失去生命，既然他来了这个世界，就一定要尽自己所能，帮天下百姓早日过上和乐安康的生活！
content_en:
Chen Xiucai and others looked at Qiu Chuji's despairing look and felt that fate was playing tricks on him.
It is true that Qiu Chuji really wanted to help them sincerely, but their families did lose their lives because of his aggressiveness! How can they accept this!
Ma Wu watched Qiu Chuji apologize, his eyes were red. After a moment of silence, he stepped forward and slapped him. Then he couldn't help but collapsed on the ground and cried, "Xiu Niang, Er Gou, have you seen it? The person who harmed you finally apologized, finally apologized! But you will never come back!"
Although the people of the Quanzhen Sect were dissatisfied with their family members being treated like this, they couldn't bear to say anything when they looked at Ma Wu's appearance! After all, what they say is true!
Qiu Chuji was slapped, but he was calm. This was what he should bear.
"If any of you want to fight, just come forward, Pindao will never fight back!"
Chen Xiucai had studied in a private school for several years and had more knowledge than others. He understood that the court wanted to rectify the people in the world, but he would not say anything more! Looking at Qiu Chuji's appearance again, he couldn't help but sigh: "Well, when will the injustice be repaid! Although Daoist Qiu made an unintentional mistake, it is a fact that it affected innocent people. I will not slap this old man. I just hope that Daoist Qiu can promise me one thing!"
"Say it! As long as I can do it, I will definitely do it!"
"After today, I hope that Daoist Qiu will not engage in so-called chivalrous acts of justice. I don't want anyone to end up like my little girl again! If Daoist Qiu is willing, he can copy more scriptures to my little girl and pray for her to have a stable next life!"
"You..."
Chen Xiucai didn't say anything more, but turned and left. They say that people become better with age, but he actually saw that Qiu Chuji had a death wish. For such a person, living is the most painful thing. This can be regarded as atonement for him! But thinking about his daughter who would never come back, Chen Xiucai couldn't help but burst into tears!
Qiu Chuji looked at Chen Xiucai's faltering steps as he walked away, feeling mixed emotions in his heart.
Chen An saw that the matter in front of him was almost solved, and the remaining things were beyond his control, so he walked up to Qiu Chuji and informed him directly: "Taoist Qiu, since these things are almost settled, I will lead the army to retreat from Zhongnan Mountain!"
After finishing speaking, without looking at Qiu Chuji's reaction, he directly said loudly: "We won't go into details about the heroic deeds of all of you in the past. After all, no one has ever taken care of them. But from today on, no more private murders will be allowed in Daijin. If you find someone committing a crime, Matters can be reported to the government, and they are not allowed to be handled privately, nor are they allowed to use force to fight in the street. Once discovered, everyone will be severely punished! I hope no one will say that they are doing chivalry! After all, you have seen the consequences of doing chivalry! "
"When the time comes to kill people in accordance with the law and repay debts, no matter whether you are unintentional or not, a mistake is a mistake! I hope you will keep it in mind! Of course, don't think about your martial arts skills and fearlessness! After all, everyone is not alone in the world. It will be bad if your relatives and friends are implicated!"
After saying both kindness and power, Chen An directly ordered his men: "Take the troops back to camp!"
Although the people present were dissatisfied with the attitude of the golden general, they did not dare to do anything more. They were disturbed by this day and just wanted to sit down and discuss it!
I thought I was just coming to Zhongnan Mountain to watch the excitement, but I didn’t expect that I would be implicated in it!
On the other side, people from the Quanzhen Sect saw that everyone around them had dispersed and quickly helped Qiu Chuji up.
"Brother Qiu, are you okay?"
Qiu Chuji looked at the people who cared about him and felt speechless, "I'm fine, it's just that I have troubled you these days!"
"Then what will you do in the future? What happened today will spread all over the country in a short time. You..."
Looking at the faces of everyone, Qiu ChujianHe comforted: "I have caused so many innocent people to lose their lives. Now that I am still alive, it is already good. In the future, I will copy scriptures in the Taoist gym according to the agreement with Chen Xiucai. Don't worry about me! Let's go back first!"
Looking at Qiu Chuji's appearance, everyone just felt heartbroken. Normally, their senior brother always looked like he was on fire, but it was quite uncomfortable to suddenly become like this!
What happened at the foot of Zhongnan Mountain soon spread throughout the country as people came from north to south, which also caused the reputation of Qiu Chuji and the Quanzhen Sect to plummet!
It was an honest mistake, but what did the person implicated do wrong?
Even Hong Qigong, who admitted that he had never killed an innocent person, was silent for a long time, let alone the others!
Of course, the decree of Emperor Jin was also spread, and many vendors were very happy for this!
They really hate those people who fight on the street. It would be good if they only lose a little goods, but they are afraid of meeting someone with red eyes, and they are also afraid of being implicated and losing their lives!
Now that this order is issued, everyone feels that their stalls are secure and they are no longer afraid of meeting these knights!
But there are also people who are worried. People in the world are used to being free and easy, and suddenly a lot of restrictions are imposed on them, which they are not used to, but there is no way. Form is stronger than people. No matter how powerful they are, they can't resist a country, not to mention that not all of their relatives and friends are strong in martial arts!
Seeing that the matter was over, Yang Kang returned to the imperial city. However, he was worried that some people were violating the law or breaking the law, so he specifically asked his officials to investigate such cases strictly. Once discovered, they would not tolerate it! They even sent people to patrol various places to prevent the officials below from not taking it seriously!
The officials took it seriously, but they felt that no one would go against the trend and commit crimes. However, a few people felt that Emperor Jin's order was just a talk, and the result was a direct hit on the gun. Yang Kang directly ordered to be dealt with strictly. Other people in the world became a lot more honest when they saw the fate of these people.
What Yang Kang didn't expect was that this order not only restricted the people in Jianghu, but also reduced the conflicts between neighbors. Everyone got along with each other in a lot of harmony, and there was basically no need to take action at the slightest disagreement!
However, these Jianghu people were honest in Dajin, but they still had their original virtues in Xixia during the Song Dynasty, and even vented out the grievances they suffered in Dajin. This was very helpless, but he didn't care about it for the time being, after all, it was not his territory!
However, Yang Kang believes that sooner or later, he will be able to completely change the habits of these people in the world!
Yang Kang looked at the map hanging in the study, thinking that the world had calmed down now, and he could concentrate on developing the court in the future. He must end this situation as soon as possible and complete the unification!
The first emperor's words at that time, "If you are ordered by heaven, you will live forever" aroused the passion in the hearts of many Chinese men!
Rather than letting the Mongols go south to the Central Plains, it is better to do it yourself!
Think about how many monuments were destroyed in the flames of war, and how many people lost their lives due to war. Since he came to this world, he must do his best to help people all over the world live a happy and healthy life as soon as possible!
